text_block_list.name: Rickey & Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Verxina! Happy birthday, 
Miss Verxina!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, both of you. I'm so glad for 
your present as well, Tarumae-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
We're roommates, after all! You're always 
taking care of me, so this is my way of 
saying thanks!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't sure what to get, but I went with 
a towel from the brand Verxina-san always 
uses.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'd never been in before, so going to that 
shop made me super nervous...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's a brand great for everyday use 
too, you know? Besides, if you're aiming 
for the top, you ought to be particular 
about what you use.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
On that note, I really like the towels 
here. I'll make sure to start using the 
new ones right away tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I think that's wonderful for your feng 
shui too♪ New fabric goods invite good 
opportunities and boost your overall luck!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Besides that, towels have the power 
to wipe away bad luck and purify you, so—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Purifying the flow... Then... could the 
curse of '2nd place' also be... !?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...No. Thank you, I'll make sure to 
cherish it!"
